strengths.title: Extraversion: reserved strength
strengths.interviewLine: Tell me about a time when being reserved clearly helped the outcome.
strengths.cvLine: Brought a reserved approach to [context], supporting [result].
strengths.teamLine: I tend to show up as reserved in day-to-day work.

watchOuts: can come across as too reserved when the situation needs the opposite pole

actions: This week, pick one meeting and decide in advance whether a reserved or opposite-pole move serves the goal.
Ask a trusted colleague: "When does my extraversion style help you, and when does it get in the way?"
Schedule a 15-minute practice of the opposite pole (quiet focus / outreach / structure / openness) midweek.

entries.workWithOthers: You often prefer a reserved style. Name that preference early, and ask opposite-pole colleagues what they need to work well with you.
entries.tradeOff: Leaning reserved helps in some rooms and costs recovery or coverage in others; the trade-off is real.
